financing.summary: Private, founder-led company with no public debt or SEC filings found, so its bank lines and land loans are not disclosed. It is a land-heavy self-developer: it reports 11,490 owned or controlled lots (close to ten years of supply at about 1,155 closings), develops its own master-planned communities through HBWB Development, and also buys finished lots from outside developers. The one named outside capital partner is GTIS Partners, which formed a $50M equity joint venture with the Casa Fresca subsidiary in 2021; the founder has also referred to unnamed 'capital partners'. No public link to Domain, Millrose, Kennedy Lewis or TPG Angelo Gordon was found. A long owned pipeline, growth into new counties and new build-to-rent and multifamily lines, plus a leadership and CFO handover through 2027, suggest real room for a land banker, but nothing public shows it using one today.
financing.land_strategy: Mixed, leaning toward owning and developing its own land. The company describes itself as a developer and homebuilder: it has put nearly $96M into large land purchases and is developing four master-planned communities (Hawkstone, Crosswind Ranch, Pasadena Ridge, Mitchell Falls), while also buying homesites in third-party communities such as Verona, Wellen Park, Lakewood Ranch and Waterset. No stated owned-versus-optioned target.

lots.source_title: Business Observer: Tampa Bay homebuilder names CEO for attainable housing unit
lots.note: Company release figure: 11,490 owned or controlled lots in the pipeline; the owned versus optioned split is not disclosed. At the 1,155 closings in the 2026 Builder 100 that is roughly ten years of supply (our arithmetic, not a company figure).

land_banking.description: GTIS formed a joint venture with Casa Fresca, the wholly owned entry-level subsidiary, to put $50M of equity into buying, developing, building and selling entry-level homes across the Tampa area. At announcement the venture had invested in three developments and committed to more than 440 homes.
land_banking.source_title: GTIS Partners press release: GTIS Partners Forms Joint Venture with Casa Fresca to Build Entry-Level Homes in Tampa
land_banking.note: Equity joint venture, not a lot-option land bank. A May 2022 Business Observer profile still described Casa Fresca as a $50M joint partnership with GTIS. Whether the venture is still active or has been extended is not publicly disclosed. Verification 2026-11-19: downgraded Verified -> Inferred; the 2021 release confirms the JV was formed, but its only source is older than 24 months and nothing newer confirms GTIS is still a partner.

land_banking.description: Homes by WestBay bought 174 homesites at Verona, a planned 2,500-home community on State Road 52 in Pasco County, the largest share of the first 667 homesites sold to five builders. Home sales are expected from late 2027.
land_banking.source_title: Tampa Bay Business & Wealth: Five homebuilders buy first homesites at Pasco development
land_banking.note: Reported as an acquisition of homesites from the developer; price, takedown schedule and any option or financing structure were not disclosed.

land_banking.description: Selected as one of four builders in the EVERLY neighborhood at Wellen Park in Venice, with 40 homesites; this was the company's first move south of the Tampa area.
land_banking.source_title: Homes by WestBay release: Homes by WestBay Expands Reach to Southwest Florida
land_banking.note: Lot purchase terms not disclosed. Older item, kept to show the builder-in-a-master-plan pattern.

capital_events.description: Bought 174 homesites at Verona in Pasco County from Eisenhower Property Group, the largest allocation among the five opening builders.
capital_events.source_title: Tampa Bay Business & Wealth: Five homebuilders buy first homesites at Pasco development
capital_events.note: Date is the article date; purchase price not disclosed.

capital_events.description: Announced an executive succession plan and a search for a new chief financial officer (through Ferguson Partners) to support growth as a developer and builder of for-sale and build-for-rent communities. Founder becomes CEO and board chair at end of 2027; Mark Metheny becomes president; the long-time CFO moves to COO and retires at end of 2027.
capital_events.source_title: Business Observer: Leading Tampa homebuilder names future president, seeks CFO
capital_events.note: Not a financing, but it changes who decides on land and capital.

capital_events.description: Entered multifamily and build-to-rent; the head of land said the company had invested nearly $96M in large land acquisitions and was planning communities with selected business partners. The new multifamily head's remit includes capitalization of rental projects.
capital_events.source_title: Multifamily Executive: Homes by WestBay Expands Into Multifamily and Build-to-Rent Sectors
capital_events.note: The $96M is cumulative land investment as described by the company, not a single transaction; funding source not disclosed.

capital_events.description: GTIS Partners and Casa Fresca formed a $50M equity joint venture for entry-level communities in the Tampa area.
capital_events.source_title: GTIS Partners press release: GTIS Partners Forms Joint Venture with Casa Fresca to Build Entry-Level Homes in Tampa

joint_ventures.description: $50M equity joint venture with the Casa Fresca subsidiary covering land acquisition, development, construction and sale of entry-level homes in the Tampa area; three developments and more than 440 homes committed at announcement.
joint_ventures.source_title: GTIS Partners press release: GTIS Partners Forms Joint Venture with Casa Fresca to Build Entry-Level Homes in Tampa

joint_ventures.description: The founder credited the company's relationships with its capital partners for letting it buy land quickly in spring 2020 when larger builders dropped contracts. The partners were not named.
joint_ventures.source_title: Business Observer: 2022 Top Entrepreneur: Willy Nunn
joint_ventures.note: Shows the company already uses outside capital for land, but gives no names or terms.

key_metrics.credit_ratings: None found (private company; no SEC registrant under this name)
key_metrics.source_title: Business Observer: Tampa Bay homebuilder names CEO for attainable housing unit

competitor_links.source_title: GTIS Partners press release: GTIS Partners Forms Joint Venture with Casa Fresca to Build Entry-Level Homes in Tampa
